name: What factors influence the total cost of converting a tub to a shower?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the total cost of converting a tub to a shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: The overall cost depends on chosen materials, structural conditions, and plumbing modifications. Key cost drivers include tile selection, high-end shower valves, custom glass enclosures, and whether the existing drain line must be resized or moved. If tear-out uncovers hidden moisture damage or rotted framing behind the old tub apron, repairing those elements adds to labor and material expenses. Bay City Remodeling & Bathrooms provides free quotes and negotiable pricing, as well as veteran discounts, to accommodate varied project scopes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary based on custom tile choices, glass doors, plumbing reconfigurations, and necessary subfloor or drywall repairs uncovered behind the old bathtub.
